summary: Linkers Industries Ltd, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Linkers Asia Pacific Limited, filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Share Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire 150,800 shares representing 29% of LPW Electronics Co., Ltd. from Chairman Mr. Man Tak Lau for ~US$2,350,000, with outstanding LPW associate debt of ~US$6,160,000 to be settled in cash at closing. The registrant currently owns 20% of LPW and will hold 49% post-closing. Closing is expected on or around June 17, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or mechanics details are provided. The consideration is cash. Watch for regulatory approval and completion of debt settlement.
